name: Ambulatorio Veterinario Dott. Mariani Luigi Angelo
short_description: Veterinary clinic established in 1988 offering surgery, radiology, ultrasound and exotic pet care.
short_description_local: Ambulatorio veterinario attivo dal 1988 con chirurgia, radiologia, ecografia e cura degli esotici.
description: Founded in 1988, Ambulatorio Veterinario Mariani provides comprehensive veterinary care for dogs, cats, and rabbits. Medical services include soft-tissue surgery, cytology, radiology, ultrasound diagnostics, and in-house laboratory testing.

name: Ambulatorio Veterinario Dr. Vicla Sgaravatti
short_description: Veterinary clinic offering clinical care, dentistry and home visits across Milan.

description: Ambulatorio Veterinario Dr. Vicla Sgaravatti provides medical examinations, preventive healthcare, and ultrasonic dental tartar removal for pets. The practice also offers veterinary home visits in Milan and surrounding municipalities, as well as microchip identification.
description_local: L'Ambulatorio Veterinario Dr. Vicla Sgaravatti offre visite cliniche, medicina preventiva e ablazione del tartaro a ultrasuoni per animali da compagnia. La dottoressa esegue inoltre visite a domicilio a Milano e nei comuni limitrofi, oltre all'applicazione del microchip.
